item.title: APGA asks Abaribe, Ikwechegh to vacate NASS seats after defection
item.description: Abia State chapter of the All Progressives Grand Alliance, APGA, has called on two federal lawmakers, Enyinnaya Abaribe and Alex Mascot Ikwechegh, to vacate their seats in the National Assembly following their recent defections to other political parties. item.title: 2027: PDP deserted as Bala Mohammed, Seyi Makinde set to dump party
item.description: Barely any last minute change, Governor Bala Mohammed of Bauchi State and his Oyo State counterpart Seyi Makinde will quit their membership of the Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, before April, DAILY POST reports. item.title: Police arrest more suspects over killing of Lagos monarch’s son
item.description: Lagos State Police Command has apprehended more suspects in connection with the murder of Prince Ademola Akinloye, the son of the Ajiran of Agungi, Oba Tijani Akinloye. Prince Akinloye was reportedly shot and brutally attacked by gunmen on August 26, 2024, along Chevron Drive near Ebeano Supermarket in the Agungi area of Lagos. item.title: LaLiga: Adams delighted after ending Sevilla drought
item.description: Akor Adams can’t hide his excitement after ending his six-game goal drought at Spanish club, Sevilla, DAILY POST reports.
